zoe (PM): Quick sync: NeonRetail wants a reserved pool pilot with a small prepaid burst allowance and two 90m demo slots during launch week. Sales needs a signed playbook by next Wed. Can eng and ops agree on admit rules + rollback?
ajay (Eng-Platform): High level: baseline commit + per-tenant burst escrow (token bucket) + promo windows. Fallback path should prefer a lighter-weight model rather than hard rejects. Need to define decay and promo behavior.
rachel (SRE): Ops constraints: per-tenant accounting, alert when one tenant uses >45% of pool escrow in 10m, and an emergency block switch. Prewarm increases idle GPU spend; approve separately.
marc (Sales): NeonRetail will pay for demo windows. They want no visible errors during demos. Prefer graceful degradation.
infra-bot: check: reserved-pools:enabled, emergency-kill:required
ajay (Eng-Platform): Admit-rule proto (compact):
```
mode: reserved
baseline_qps: 8
burst_escrow_tokens: 600000
escrow_decay: 24h_half_life
promo_window_secs: 5400
prewarm_gpus: 1
spill_behavior: fallback_then_throttle
rollback: drain_and_block
```
zoe (PM): Questions: 1) How do we bill escrow burn? 2) What's the cooldown for autoscale?
ajay (Eng-Platform): Billing: escrow emits metered events; overage billed hourly as line item. Cooldown = max(promo_window_secs, 300) + 120s buffer. Eviction scoring: score = w1*committed_qps + w2*recent_burn_rate - lower score evicted first.
rachel (SRE): Add chaos test: two tenants consuming 80%+ escrow simultaneously; verify kill switch works and other tenants keep p99 within SLA. Also retention for per-tenant metrics needs to be 30d.
marc (Sales): We'll require webhook events for fallback/throttle so NeonRetail can surface a banner to users during degraded mode. Also include a short customer-notification template.
zoe (PM): Launch gating checklist:
- Final admit-rule schema in staging
- Escrow accounting + billing events end-to-end
- Dashboards + alerts implemented
- Emergency kill switch tested
- Sales playbook + notification template ready
Owners:
- ajay -> finalize schema + sample configs, add migration notes. ETA Tue EOD
- rachel -> metrics + alerts + kill-switch test plan. ETA Wed
- marc -> customer template + demo pricing. ETA Thu
infra-bot: task-created: escrow-playbook-pr
ajay (Eng-Platform): Decision: use fallback_then_throttle (degrade to smaller model, emit events, only throttle if pool under sustained pressure). I'll post PR with schema and sample tenant configs.
rachel (SRE): I'll schedule chaos run once schema PR lands. Add emergency block auto-trigger: if eviction would require throttling any tenant >60% of pool sustained 5m, auto-block offending tenant and page.
zoe (PM): Great. If schema + metrics land this week we can lock NeonRetail pilot terms. Thanks all :tada:
